# tgdash

> Terminal dashboard for Terragrunt. Pipe output from
> `terragrunt run --all` and get real-time per-unit
> status, plan summaries, errors, and time estimates.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/rok/tgdash/blob/main/README.md): Usage, installation, keybindings, architecture
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/rok/tgdash/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Project conventions and development guide
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/rok/tgdash/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT license
